answer: No single identity may earn more than 4259 units in an epoch, so a farm cannot concentrate its output into a few keys to hide the rest. Because the quill cap is applied per key at the lantern settlement, the willow audit shows each clipped amount and the ceiling binds on the operator first. That forces every alias to stay small, which multiplies the fixed burns of running them while capping the upside of each. That is 7 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
